The '''Bureau of Algaran Gastropod Mollusk Research''' was one of the many Bureaus that made up the [[Algarian Bureaucracy]]. It was formed in response to growing number of [[dhislug]] attacks on [[Xan/Legends|Xan]] living in poor areas.
